ideas.pitch: An ElevenLabs-powered voice-controlled telemetry assistant for monitoring simulated rocket launches and spacecraft status hands-free during mission operations.
ideas.title: AstroVox Mission Control
ideas.why_it_could_win: ElevenLabs is explicitly listed as a sponsor, meaning building a core feature directly utilizing their voice generation or conversational AI APIs targets the sponsor track with less competition.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered interactive space-themed campus guide for Guru Nanak Dev Engineering College that gives audio-guided directions for visitors during the event.
ideas.title: NebulaGuide Campus Navigation
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves a localized problem directly experienced by the judges, participants, and visitors navigating the Guru Nanak Dev Engineering College campus during the 24-hour event.

ideas.pitch: A safety check-in and coordination platform built by a diverse team to help hackathon participants track their team members across the sprawling college venue at night.
ideas.title: CosmicCrew SafeReturn
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly aligns with the Best Girls Team or Best Freshers team criteria by prioritizing safety and collaborative coordination within a tight student demographic.

ideas.pitch: A voice-first documentation logger that allows sleepy midnight hackers to speak their code updates and bug fixes into an ElevenLabs-transcribed and summarized dev journal.
ideas.title: Singularity Audio Log
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the ElevenLabs sponsor technology to solve a universal pain point that all hackers and organizers experience during 24-hour hackathons: documenting progress while exhausted.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight satellite tracking dashboard that visualizes near-Earth space debris and alerts operators using synthesized audio briefings.
ideas.title: OrbitWatch Space Debris Monitor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Fits the space-themed branding of Hacknauts 2.0 while integrating sponsor audio tech to create an engaging presentation for the judging panel.
